status_summary.name: Status Summary Report
status_summary.query: SELECT status, COUNT(*) as count FROM task_transaction tt JOIN facility f ON tt.facility_id = f.id WHERE f.company_id = {company_id} GROUP BY status ORDER BY count DESC;

completed_tasks.name: Completed Tasks Report
completed_tasks.description: All completed tasks with user names
completed_tasks.query: SELECT tt.task_id, td.name as task_name, tt.status, tt.priority, tt.scheduled_date, tt.closed_date, u.first_name, u.last_name FROM task_transaction tt JOIN task_description td ON tt.task_description_id = td.id JOIN facility f ON tt.facility_id = f.id LEFT JOIN user u ON tt.assigned_user_id = u.id WHERE f.company_id = {company_id} AND tt.status = 'Completed' ORDER BY tt.closed_date DESC LIMIT 100;

pending_tasks.name: Pending Tasks Report
pending_tasks.query: SELECT tt.task_id, td.name as task_name, tt.priority, tt.scheduled_date, u.first_name, u.last_name, fac.name as facility_name FROM task_transaction tt JOIN task_description td ON tt.task_description_id = td.id JOIN facility fac ON tt.facility_id = fac.id LEFT JOIN user u ON tt.assigned_user_id = u.id WHERE fac.company_id = {company_id} AND tt.status = 'Pending' ORDER BY tt.priority ASC, tt.scheduled_date ASC LIMIT 100;

overdue_tasks.name: Overdue Tasks Report
overdue_tasks.description: Tasks past scheduled date and not completed
overdue_tasks.query: SELECT tt.task_id, td.name as task_name, tt.status, tt.priority, tt.scheduled_date, DATEDIFF(NOW(), tt.scheduled_date) as days_overdue, u.first_name, u.last_name FROM task_transaction tt JOIN task_description td ON tt.task_description_id = td.id JOIN facility f ON tt.facility_id = f.id LEFT JOIN user u ON tt.assigned_user_id = u.id WHERE f.company_id = {company_id} AND tt.status != 'Completed' AND tt.scheduled_date < NOW() ORDER BY days_overdue DESC LIMIT 100;

user_performance.name: User Performance Report
user_performance.query: SELECT u.first_name, u.last_name, COUNT(*) as total_tasks, SUM(CASE WHEN tt.status = 'Completed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as completed, SUM(CASE WHEN tt.status = 'Pending' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as pending, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN tt.status = 'Completed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) as completion_rate FROM task_transaction tt JOIN facility f ON tt.facility_id = f.id LEFT JOIN user u ON tt.assigned_user_id = u.id WHERE f.company_id = {company_id} GROUP BY u.id, u.first_name, u.last_name ORDER BY completion_rate DESC;

user_workload.name: User Workload Report
user_workload.query: SELECT u.first_name, u.last_name, COUNT(*) as pending_tasks, SUM(CASE WHEN tt.priority = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as high_priority FROM task_transaction tt JOIN facility f ON tt.facility_id = f.id LEFT JOIN user u ON tt.assigned_user_id = u.id WHERE f.company_id = {company_id} AND tt.status = 'Pending' GROUP BY u.id, u.first_name, u.last_name ORDER BY pending_tasks DESC;

today_tasks.name: Today's Tasks Report
today_tasks.query: SELECT tt.task_id, td.name as task_name, tt.status, tt.priority, u.first_name, u.last_name, fac.name as facility_name FROM task_transaction tt JOIN task_description td ON tt.task_description_id = td.id JOIN facility fac ON tt.facility_id = fac.id LEFT JOIN user u ON tt.assigned_user_id = u.id WHERE fac.company_id = {company_id} AND DATE(tt.scheduled_date) = CURDATE() ORDER BY tt.priority ASC;

weekly_tasks.name: This Week's Tasks Report
weekly_tasks.query: SELECT tt.task_id, td.name as task_name, tt.status, tt.priority, tt.scheduled_date, u.first_name, u.last_name FROM task_transaction tt JOIN task_description td ON tt.task_description_id = td.id JOIN facility f ON tt.facility_id = f.id LEFT JOIN user u ON tt.assigned_user_id = u.id WHERE f.company_id = {company_id} AND YEARWEEK(tt.scheduled_date, 1) = YEARWEEK(CURDATE(), 1) ORDER BY tt.scheduled_date ASC;

monthly_summary.name: Monthly Task Summary
monthly_summary.query: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(tt.scheduled_date, '%Y-%m-%d') as date, COUNT(*) as total, SUM(CASE WHEN tt.status = 'Completed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as completed, SUM(CASE WHEN tt.status = 'Pending' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as pending FROM task_transaction tt JOIN facility f ON tt.facility_id = f.id WHERE f.company_id = {company_id} AND MONTH(tt.scheduled_date) = MONTH(CURDATE()) AND YEAR(tt.scheduled_date) = YEAR(CURDATE()) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(tt.scheduled_date, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY date ASC;

facility_performance.name: Facility Performance Report
facility_performance.query: SELECT fac.name as facility_name, COUNT(*) as total_tasks, SUM(CASE WHEN tt.status = 'Completed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as completed, SUM(CASE WHEN tt.status = 'Pending' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as pending, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN tt.status = 'Completed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) as completion_rate FROM task_transaction tt JOIN facility fac ON tt.facility_id = fac.id WHERE fac.company_id = {company_id} GROUP BY fac.id, fac.name ORDER BY completion_rate DESC;

facility_workload.name: Facility Workload Report
facility_workload.query: SELECT fac.name as facility_name, COUNT(*) as pending_tasks, SUM(CASE WHEN tt.priority = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as high_priority FROM task_transaction tt JOIN facility fac ON tt.facility_id = fac.id WHERE fac.company_id = {company_id} AND tt.status = 'Pending' GROUP BY fac.id, fac.name ORDER BY pending_tasks DESC;

asset_maintenance.name: Asset Maintenance Report
asset_maintenance.query: SELECT a.name as asset_name, COUNT(*) as total_tasks, SUM(CASE WHEN tt.status = 'Completed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as completed, MAX(tt.scheduled_date) as last_maintenance FROM task_transaction tt JOIN asset a ON tt.asset_id = a.id JOIN facility f ON tt.facility_id = f.id WHERE f.company_id = {company_id} GROUP BY a.id, a.name ORDER BY last_maintenance DESC;

priority_distribution.name: Priority Distribution Report
priority_distribution.query: SELECT tt.priority, COUNT(*) as count, SUM(CASE WHEN tt.status = 'Completed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as completed, SUM(CASE WHEN tt.status = 'Pending' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as pending FROM task_transaction tt JOIN facility f ON tt.facility_id = f.id WHERE f.company_id = {company_id} GROUP BY tt.priority ORDER BY tt.priority ASC;

task_type_frequency.name: Task Type Frequency Report
task_type_frequency.query: SELECT td.name as task_type, COUNT(*) as frequency, SUM(CASE WHEN tt.status = 'Completed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as completed FROM task_transaction tt JOIN task_description td ON tt.task_description_id = td.id JOIN facility f ON tt.facility_id = f.id WHERE f.company_id = {company_id} GROUP BY td.id, td.name ORDER BY frequency DESC LIMIT 20;

completion_time_analysis.name: Task Completion Time Analysis
completion_time_analysis.query: SELECT td.name as task_type, COUNT(*) as completed_count, AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, tt.scheduled_date, CONCAT(tt.closed_date, ' ', tt.closed_time))) as avg_hours_to_complete FROM task_transaction tt JOIN task_description td ON tt.task_description_id = td.id JOIN facility f ON tt.facility_id = f.id WHERE f.company_id = {company_id} AND tt.status = 'Completed' AND tt.closed_date IS NOT NULL GROUP BY td.id, td.name ORDER BY completed_count DESC LIMIT 20;

sla_compliance.name: SLA Compliance Report
sla_compliance.description: Tasks completed on time vs overdue
sla_compliance.query: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(tt.scheduled_date, '%Y-%m') as month, COUNT(*) as total_completed, SUM(CASE WHEN CONCAT(tt.closed_date, ' ', tt.closed_time) <= tt.scheduled_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as on_time, SUM(CASE WHEN CONCAT(tt.closed_date, ' ', tt.closed_time) > tt.scheduled_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as late, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN CONCAT(tt.closed_date, ' ', tt.closed_time) <= tt.scheduled_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) as sla_compliance_rate FROM task_transaction tt JOIN facility f ON tt.facility_id = f.id WHERE f.company_id = {company_id} AND tt.status = 'Completed' AND tt.closed_date IS NOT NULL GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(tt.scheduled_date, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY month DESC LIMIT 12;
